The agent explained that the artwork design must be submitted and approved before the order can be confirmed. The caller said the design was not ready and would be sent later, then reconfirmed the product, quantity, budget, delivery location, and COD preference and asked whether anything else was needed. The agent said the design was the remaining requirement but clarified that no team handoff or follow-up could be promised. The order was not confirmed during the call.
